1. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel, forming an inner panel-extension joint, and attached to the door outer panel via a direct mechanical attachment, forming an outer panel-extension joint, to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel.

2. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the outer panel-extension joint is a hemmed joint __formed by folding the panel extension around an edge of the door outer panel__.

3. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the inner panel-extension joint includes __multiple__ fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel.

4. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 including at least one hinge that is mounted directly to the common door inner panel __without an intermediate frame member__.

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Original) A method of assembling a vehicle door, the method comprising the steps of: (a) forming a panel extension separate from a common door inner panel and a door outer panel; (b) attaching the panel extension to the door outer panel; (c) mounting door hardware to the common door inner panel; and (d) attaching the panel extension to a periphery of the common door inner panel.

7. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein step (b) is further defined by hemming the panel extension to the door outer panel.

8. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein step (d) is further defined by attaching fasteners to the panel extension and the common door inner panel.

9. (Original) The method of claim 8 wherein step (d) is further defined by the fasteners being rivets, and the panel extension being riveted to the common door inner panel.

10. (Cancelled)
